## Update after the full build: SH-AFT notch

The single contact above (SH-AFT / CH-ATT-R, 2.1 cm³) has been fixed. SH-AFT now has a local notch around the CH-ATT-R plate and eye, with 5 mm clearance all round (`cad/e8cad/fuselage.py`).

- The part was regenerated on its own, and the pair re-checked with watertight meshes: overlap 0 mm³.
- SH-AFT mass went from 6.496 to 6.470 kg.
- The assembly STEP (.xz) still shows the earlier contact. It picks up the notch on the next full build.
